ROOT.scriptdef: if exists (select name from sysobjects where name = 'POS_EksportKodyKreskowe' and type = 'P') drop procedure CDN.POS_EksportKodyKreskowe;

CREATE PROCEDURE [CDN].[POS_EksportKodyKreskowe] @rowVersion bigint, @PointOfSaleId int AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON;
declare @kody TABLE( Id int, LotId int, ProductUnitId int, Code nvarchar(41), Type int, TwK_CzasModyfikacji int )
INSERT INTO @kody select MIN(TPa_Id) as [@Id], MIN(TPa_Id) as [@LotId], isnull((select Twj_Id from CDN.TwrJm where TwJ_JmZ=isnull(max(TwK_Jm),max(twr_jm)) AND twj_twrnumer=TPa_TwrNumer),-TPa_TwrNumer) as [@ProductUnitId], isnull(max(TwK_Kod),TPa_Ean) as [@Code], CASE when max(TwK_TypKodu) is null then 3 when max(TwK_TypKodu)=0 then 1 when max(TwK_TypKodu)=1 then 2 else 3 end as [@Type], isnull(max(TwK_CzasModyfikacji),0) from cdn.TwrPartie join cdn.TwrKarty on Twr_GIDNumer = TPa_TwrNumer join cdn.Dostawy on TPa_Id = Dst_TpAID left join cdn.TwrKody on case when TPa_Ean = '' and TPa_Cecha = '' and TPa_DataW = 0 and TPa_DstNumer = 0 then twr_ean else tpa_ean end = TwK_Kod and TwK_TwrNumer = TPa_TwrNumer left join cdn.TwrZasoby on Dst_GIDNumer = TwZ_DstNumer left join cdn.Magazyny on TwZ_MagNumer = MAG_GIDNumer AND TwZ_MagTyp = MAG_GIDTyp left join cdn.FrmObiekty on MAG_GIDNumer=FRO_GIDNumer AND MAG_GIDTyp = Fro_GidTyp left join cdn.FrmStruktura on FRS_ID=FRO_FRMID left join cdn.PicoKonfig on PcK_CentrumID = FrS_ID left join cdn.picostanowiska on PSa_PcKID = pck_picoid and PSa_Id = @PointOfSaleId where TPa_TwrNumer in (select TwrGidNumer from CDN.POS_TwrDoEksportu(@PointOfSaleId,0)) AND (psa_id is not null or TwZ_Ilosc is null) AND (TwK_CzasModyfikacji is null OR TwK_CzasModyfikacji > @rowVersion OR @rowVersion=0) group by TPa_TwrNumer,TPa_DataW,TPa_Cecha,TPa_Ean,TpA_CCKNumer
declare @LastMod bigint = (select max(TwK_CzasModyfikacji) from @kody)
SELECT @LastMod AS [@RowVersion] ,( select Id as [@Id], LotId as [@LotId], ProductUnitId as [@ProductUnitId], Code as [@Code], Type as [@Type] from @kody for xml path('Barcode'), type) for xml path('Barcodes') SET NOCOUNT OFF; END
GRANT EXECUTE ON CDN.POS_EksportKodyKreskowe TO CDNRaport
